      cursor: grabbing;
    }

    .vignette {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 44%, transparent 45%, rgba(44, 61, 55, 0.11) 100%);
    }

    .label {
      position: fixed;
      top: 28px;
      left: 30px;
      pointer-events: none;
      color: #30413d;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    }

    .label h1 {
      margin: 0 0 5px;
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size: clamp(25px, 3vw, 38px);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.015em;
    }

    .label p {
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(48, 65, 61, 0.72);
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .hint {
      position: fixed;
      right: 24px;
      bottom: 20px;
      padding: 9px 13px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(55, 75, 68, 0.14);
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(245, 249, 246, 0.66);
      color: rgba(45, 63, 57, 0.68);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 0.035em;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    button {
      position: fixed;
      top: 28px;
      right: 28px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(55, 75, 68, 0.18);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 9px 14px;
      background: rgba(245, 249, 246, 0.72);
      color: #354b45;
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      cursor: pointer;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }

    button:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .label {
        top: 20px;
        left: 20px;
      }

      .label p {
        max-width: 220px;
        line-height: 1.5;
      }

      button {
        top: 20px;
        right: 18px;
      }

      .hint {
        right: 50%;
        bottom: 16px;
        transform: translateX(50%);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="label">
    <h1>Brittle Star</h1>
    <p>Draped across a barrel sponge</p>
  </div>

  <button id="reset" type="button">Reset view</button>
  <div class="hint">Drag to orbit · Scroll or pinch to zoom</div>
  <div class="vignette"></div>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xdce7e3);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xdce7e3, 10, 24);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      37,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    document.body.prepend(renderer.domElement);

    // Lighting
    scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xf4fbf7, 0x8a765d, 2.1));

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff3d8, 4.2);
    keyLight.position.set(-3.8, 7.5, 4.8);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 6;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -3;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 18;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.00035;
    keyLight.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xc8e2e5, 1.25);
    fillLight.position.set(4, 3, -5);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    const rimLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffe4b5, 18, 12, 2);
    rimLight.position.set(-2.5, 4.5, -2.5);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    // Ground
    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(80, 80),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xd6e1dd,
        roughness: 1
      })
    );
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    ground.position.y = -0.025;
    ground.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(ground);

    // Procedural sponge textures
    function createSpongeColorTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = canvas.height = 512;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(256, 180, 40, 256, 256, 350);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, "#f8edcf");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.7, "#e7d3ad");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "#cbb58d");
      ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);

      for (let i = 0; i < 950; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * 512;
        const y = Math.random() * 512;
        const radius = 0.4 + Math.random() * 3.4;
        const dark = Math.random() > 0.45;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(
          x,
          y,
          radius,
          radius * (0.45 + Math.random() * 0.55),
          Math.random() * Math.PI,
          0,
          Math.PI * 2
        );
        ctx.fillStyle = dark
          ? `rgba(83, 61, 38, ${0.08 + Math.random() * 0.2})`
          : `rgba(255, 248, 224, ${0.12 + Math.random() * 0.22})`;
        ctx.fill();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(2.8, 2.1);
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    function createSpongeBumpTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = canvas.height = 512;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      ctx.fillStyle = "#777777";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);

      for (let i = 0; i < 1100; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * 512;
        const y = Math.random() * 512;
        const radius = 0.6 + Math.random() * 3.2;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(
          x,
          y,
          radius,
          radius * (0.45 + Math.random() * 0.6),
          Math.random() * Math.PI,
          0,
          Math.PI * 2
        );
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(35, 35, 35, ${0.18 + Math.random() * 0.45})`;
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(
          x - radius * 0.2,
          y - radius * 0.15,
          radius * 0.45,
          radius * 0.25,
          Math.random() * Math.PI,
          0,
          Math.PI * 2
        );
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(170, 170, 170, 0.22)";
        ctx.fill();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(3, 2.1);
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    function createArmBumpTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = canvas.height = 256;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      ctx.fillStyle = "#777";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);

      for (let i = 0; i < 1800; i++) {
        const value = 80 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 90);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${value}, ${value}, ${value})`;
        ctx.fillRect(
          Math.random() * 256,
          Math.random() * 256,
          1 + Math.random() * 2,
          1 + Math.random() * 2
        );
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(5, 2);
      return texture;
    }

    function createDiscColorTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = canvas.height = 512;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(256, 210, 30, 256, 256, 330);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, "#d6d1c2");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.55, "#b8b4a7");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "#8f9188");
      ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);

      for (let i = 0; i < 450; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * 512;
        const y = Math.random() * 512;
        const radius = 1 + Math.random() * 8;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(65, 68, 61, ${0.035 + Math.random() * 0.11})`;
        ctx.fill();
      }

      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(85, 88, 81, 0.14)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      for (const radius of [95, 170, 245, 320]) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(256, 215, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    function createDiscBumpTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = canvas.height = 256;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      ctx.fillStyle = "#888";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);

      for (let i = 0; i < 1200; i++) {
        const gray = 90 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 85);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${gray}, ${gray}, ${gray})`;
        ctx.fillRect(
          Math.random() * 256,
          Math.random() * 256,
          1 + Math.random() * 2,
          1 + Math.random() * 2
        );
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    // Barrel-shaped sponge
    const spongeProfile = [
      new THREE.Vector2(0.00, 0.00),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.00, 0.00),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.27, 0.10),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.49, 0.45),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.60, 0.90),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.61, 1.40),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.57, 1.90),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.52, 2.20),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.48, 2.46),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.45, 2.60),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.30, 2.72),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.85, 2.80),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.35, 2.85),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.00, 2.88)
    ];

    const spongeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xf3e2bd,
      map: createSpongeColorTexture(),
      bumpMap: createSpongeBumpTexture(),
      bumpScale: 0.075,
      roughness: 0.98,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const sponge = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.LatheGeometry(spongeProfile, 96),
      spongeMaterial
    );
    sponge.castShadow = true;
    sponge.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(sponge);

    // Raised sponge rim
    const rim = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.465, 0.13, 14, 96),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xe7cf9e,
        map: createSpongeColorTexture(),
        bumpMap: createSpongeBumpTexture(),
        bumpScale: 0.055,
        roughness: 1
      })
    );
    rim.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    rim.position.y = 2.48;
    rim.castShadow = true;
    rim.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(rim);

    // Brittle star materials
    const armMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xa9ada0,
      roughness: 0.86,
      metalness: 0,
      bumpMap: createArmBumpTexture(),
      bumpScale: 0.018
    });

    const jointMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x8f9187,
      roughness: 0.9,
      bumpMap: createArmBumpTexture(),
      bumpScale: 0.015
    });

    const spineMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xc3c1b3,
      roughness: 0.88,
      bumpMap: createArmBumpTexture(),
      bumpScale: 0.012
    });

    const discMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xc3beb1,
      map: createDiscColorTexture(),
      bumpMap: createDiscBumpTexture(),
      bumpScale: 0.028,
      roughness: 0.9
    });

    // Central disc
    const disc = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.72, 48, 24),
      discMaterial
    );
    disc.scale.y = 0.27;
    disc.position.y = 2.68;
    disc.castShadow = true;
    disc.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(disc);

    // Small papillae around the central disc
    const papillaGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 10, 8);
    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      const angle = (i / 18) * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = 0.61;
      const y = 2.68 + 0.72 * Math.sqrt(1 - Math.pow(radius / 0.72, 2)) * 0.27;

      const papilla = new THREE.Mesh(papillaGeometry, spineMaterial);
      papilla.scale.setScalar(0.035 + Math.random() * 0.018);
      papilla.position.set(
        Math.cos(angle) * radius,
        y + 0.012,
        Math.sin(angle) * radius
      );
      papilla.castShadow = true;
      scene.add(papilla);
    }

    // Articulated, tapered arms
    const unitCylinder = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 10, 1, false);
    const jointSphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 14, 10);
    const spineSphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 10, 8);
    const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

    const armBases = [0.12, 2.36, 4.57, 6.78, 8.99];
    const armBends = [-0.70, 0.35, 0.80, -0.45, 0.15];
    const armPhases = [0.2, 1.1, 2.0, 2.9, 3.8];

    function createArm(baseAngle, bend, phase) {
      const points = [];

      const radialProfile = [
        [0.55, 2.82],
        [1.00, 2.98],
        [1.38, 2.96],
        [1.50, 2.68],
        [1.55, 2.10],
        [1.40, 1.35],
        [1.05, 0.72],
        [0.38, 0.30]
      ];

      radialProfile.forEach(([radius, y], index) => {
        const t = index / (radialProfile.length - 1);
        const angle =
          baseAngle +
          bend * Math.pow(t, 1.25) +
          Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 1.35 + phase) * 0.075;

        points.push(
          new THREE.Vector3(
            Math.cos(angle) * radius,
            y,
            Math.sin(angle) * radius
          )
        );
      });

      const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
        points,
        false,
        "catmullrom",
        0.42
      );

      const samples = curve.getPoints(16);

      for (let i = 0; i < samples.length - 1; i++) {
        const p = samples[i];
        const q = samples[i + 1];
        const direction = q.clone().sub(p);
        const length = direction.length();
        direction.normalize();

        const t = i / (samples.length - 2);
        const radius = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(0.046, 0.018, t);
        const segment = new THREE.Mesh(unitCylinder, armMaterial);

        segment.position.copy(p).add(q).multiplyScalar(0.5);
        segment.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(up, direction);
        segment.scale.set(radius, length, radius);
        segment.castShadow = true;
        segment.receiveShadow = true;
        scene.add(segment);
      }

      samples.forEach((point, index) => {
        const joint = new THREE.Mesh(jointSphere, jointMaterial);
        joint.scale.setScalar(index % 3 === 0 ? 0.065 : 0.051);
        joint.position.copy(point);
        joint.castShadow = true;
        scene.add(joint);

        if (index % 2 === 0) {
          const spine = new THREE.Mesh(spineSphere, spineMaterial);
          spine.scale.setScalar(0.022 + Math.random() * 0.008);
          spine.position.copy(point).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.012, 0));
          spine.castShadow = true;
          scene.add(spine);
        }
      });

      // Larger basal swelling where the arm meets the disc
      const base = points[0];
      const baseNode = new THREE.Mesh(jointSphere, jointMaterial);
      baseNode.scale.setScalar(0.105);
      baseNode.position.copy(base);
      baseNode.castShadow = true;
      scene.add(baseNode);
    }

    armBases.forEach((angle, index) => {
      createArm(angle, armBends[index], armPhases[index]);
    });

    // Custom camera controls, implemented without external controls modules
    const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.65, 0);
    const defaultView = {
      radius: 6.8,
      theta: 0.62,
      phi: 1.08
    };

    let radius = defaultView.radius;
    let theta = defaultView.theta;
    let phi = defaultView.phi;
    const pointers = new Map();
    let previousPinchDistance = 0;

    function updateCamera() {
      const sinPhi = Math.sin(phi);

      camera.position.set(
        target.x + radius * sinPhi * Math.sin(theta),
        target.y + radius * Math.cos(phi),
        target.z + radius * sinPhi * Math.cos(theta)
      );

      camera.lookAt(target);
    }

    function resetView() {
      radius = defaultView.radius;
      theta = defaultView.theta;
      phi = defaultView.phi;
      updateCamera();
    }

    function pointerDistance() {
      const values = [...pointers.values()];
      if (values.length < 2) return 0;

      return Math.hypot(
        values[0].x - values[1].x,
        values[0].y - values[1].y
      );
    }

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      renderer.domElement.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      pointers.set(event.pointerId, { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY });

      if (pointers.size === 2) {
        previousPinchDistance = pointerDistance();
      }
    });

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!pointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;

      const previous = pointers.get(event.pointerId);
      const dx = event.clientX - previous.x;
      const dy = event.clientY - previous.y;

      pointers.set(event.pointerId, { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY });

      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        theta -= dx * 0.006;
        phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(phi - dy * 0.005, 0.25, 1.48);
      } else if (pointers.size === 2) {
        const distance = pointerDistance();

        if (previousPinchDistance > 0 && distance > 0) {
          radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            radius * (previousPinchDistance / distance),
            4.1,
            11
          );
        }

        previousPinchDistance = distance;
      }

      updateCamera();
    });

    function releasePointer(event) {
      pointers.delete(event.pointerId);
      previousPinchDistance = pointers.size === 2 ? pointerDistance() : 0;
    }

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerup", releasePointer);
    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointercancel", releasePointer);
    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", releasePointer);

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          radius * Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001),
          4.1,
          11
        );
        updateCamera();
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("dblclick", resetView);
    document.getElementById("reset").addEventListener("click", resetView);

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    });

    updateCamera();
    renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => renderer.render(scene, camera));
  </script>
</body>
</html>
